Here we create shapefiles used to create burn severity rasters in Google Earth Engine (https://code.earthengine.google.com/) following Parks methods (add doi). The burn severity rasters are then used to create DoB rasters in the next script.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE)
```

```{r packages, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
```

# Load MTBS

```{r mtbs}
# Using perimeter data for 1984-2024
mtbs <- st_read("D:/Spatial_Data/mtbs_perimeter_data/mtbs_perims_DD.shp", quiet = TRUE) %>% 
  st_transform("EPSG:26913") %>% 
  mutate(Ig_Date = as.Date(Ig_Date), Fire_Year = year(Ig_Date)) %>%  
  filter(Incid_Type=="Wildfire") %>%
  st_make_valid()
```

# Subset to My Primary Fires and "Treatment" Fires

Primary Fires
```{r primary-fires}
fires <- st_read(here("data", "processed", "fuels_analysis.gpkg"), layer = "fires", quiet = TRUE)

primary_fires <- mtbs %>%
  filter(Event_ID %in% fires$Event_ID)
```

Treatment Fires
```{r treat-fires}
treatments <- st_read(here("data", "processed", "fuels_analysis.gpkg"), layer = "treatments", quiet = TRUE)

treatment_fires <- mtbs %>%
  filter(Event_ID %in% treatments$OBJECTID)
```

# Prepare for GEE and Save

```{r gee}
primary_fires %>% 
  mutate(date = as.Date(Ig_Date), "%Y%m%d") %>% # convert ignition date to date object
  mutate(Start_Day=min(lubridate::yday(date))-14) %>% # set first possible date 
  mutate(End_Day=max(lubridate::yday(date))+14) %>% # set last possible date 
  mutate(Fire_Year=year(date)) %>%
  mutate(Fire_Year=as.character(Fire_Year), Fire_ID=Event_ID) %>% # create variables with column names used in Parks code
  dplyr::select(Fire_ID, Fire_Year, Start_Day, End_Day) %>% # include only Fire ID, Fire Year, Start Day and End Day columns in dataset
  st_write(here("data", "processed", "GEE", "primary_fires_GEE.shp"), delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

treatment_fires %>% 
  mutate(date = as.Date(Ig_Date), "%Y%m%d") %>% # convert ignition date to date object
  mutate(Start_Day=min(lubridate::yday(date))-14) %>% # set first possible date 
  mutate(End_Day=max(lubridate::yday(date))+14) %>% # set last possible date 
  mutate(Fire_Year=year(date)) %>%
  mutate(Fire_Year=as.character(Fire_Year), Fire_ID=Event_ID) %>% # create variables with column names used in Parks code
  dplyr::select(Fire_ID, Fire_Year, Start_Day, End_Day) %>% # include only Fire ID, Fire Year, Start Day and End Day columns in dataset
  st_write(here("data", "processed", "GEE", "treatment_fires_GEE.shp"), delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
```
